name: Badges
author: Brett
description: Five banner badges in one plugin. Claude tests the AI connection on load (axf.llm@1). VPS watches the Claude Code login on the host. axHub is the framework's live check: green only while settings come live from axHub. AmberX shows whether the phone app is connected. The usage meter shows how much of its 5-hour and weekly limits the active Claude account has used, and its drop-down lists every saved account with what is left, reset times, active marker and status. Everything but the Claude test is plain code and costs no tokens. Each badge can be shown or hidden, set to Icons only, given a label, an icon per state (ok, warning, error, off), a side and order on the banner, and a tap action (drop-down, open a screen, run a command, toggle, nothing). Removing the plugin removes only these badges; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework.
